questionGroups.instruction: You are going to read an article about photography. For questions 31-36, choose the answer (A, B, C or D) which you think fits best according to the text.

questions.prompt: What point is the writer making in the first paragraph?

options.label: He often takes photographs of flowers in different gardens.
He is more interested in his photography than what he photographs.

He needs to be flexible when he s working.

questions.prompt: How does the writer feel about his work?

options.label: impressed by the amount of money he earns
surprised at how often he has to travel
grateful for the opportunity to observe rare events
